When is my bus arriving? How to get to the airport? Where the tram that I see is going? Where to go on a transfer? Easy Transit app answers any questions of "here and now" type, instead of swamping you with complex lists and tables.

— See live updated arrival times for the nearest bus stop.
— Go to any place from a search or choose on a map.
— Save often-visited places to bookmarks, to plan a route with a single touch.
— Pin your trip plan to consult it at transfers.
— No ads, no purchases, no data collected.

This app uses the official Tallinn public transport API to get stop arrivals: the same one used for displays at stops, but for any stop. Enhanced with OpenTripPlanner API on the official GTFS feed. It makes possible for planning trips even in Harjumaa, as well as stop timetables there. Searching is done with Photon geocoder: not as good as commercial options, but good enough, and free.

Internet connection is required, otherwise the app will have no information to display. It uses just kilobytes of traffic, unlike most transit apps. Geolocation is strongly recommended, unless you like to scroll a map — a lot.

Designed with the user of public transport in mind, but without forgetting the drivers, MobiPalma is the ultimate app for moving around Palma and now fully accessible to blind people. Welcome to sustainable mobility!

* Do you want to know when the next bus will arrive to your stop, or even get an automatic notification a few minutes before?
* Or which is the best combination of buses to get to any point in the city?
* Or how to swiftly move inside Palma combining buses and public bikes?
* Or how to make sure that your BiciPalma trip closed correctly when you leave your bike in its anchor point?

MobiPalma provides real-time, geolocated information on traffic conditions, the location and occupancy level of parking and public bicycle stations, in addition to all the information on the EMT Palma bus network. It's a free app and it's available in Catalán, Spanish, English and German.

MobiPalma is jointly promoted by the Department of Mobility of Palma de Mallorca City Hall, Emt Palma and SMAP (which manages public parkings and Bicipalma).

With the MobiPalma app you will be able to:

* Get bus arrival times exactly as in the EMT Palma app, but now also without knowing the bus stop number: choose your bus stop directly on the map; search directly by stop number, seeing the matches as you type; use the new text search engine for locating stops by street name. You can also get the bus arrival time from other screens of the app such as line information.

* Calculate routes between a source and a destination using the bus network or using different combinations of bus, public bike and parkings. You can set the source and destination of the route by searching for street names or places: a hotel, a restaurant, a bar, a shop or a mall... And of course, you can select any point directly on a map of the city that shows your location.

* Consult the information on all bus lines and all bus stops on the network.

* View the closest stops to your location represented on the city map.


* Schedule automatic reminders to be at the stop at the right time and don't miss the bus anymore.

* Mark your usual bus stops as favorites and save them with a name for convenience.

* Add to Favorites screen: bus lines, the combination of line and bus stop, Bicipalma bike stations, public car parks, urban road sections with data traffic congestion data and public traffic cameras.

* Check at a glance the status of all your favorites by just opening the app (since "Your Favorites" is the initial screen), and even see the arrival time of your favorite stop-line combinations without touching the screen.

* View on a map the congestion status of the main roads of the city.

* Take a look at the live feed of various public traffic cameras.

* Go with your car to a car park knowing in advance the number of available slots and compare the price with other nearby parking options.

* Go to a BiciPalma bike station knowing in advance the number of available bikes and open anchor points, as well as any unusable ones.

* Automatically receive a 25, 30 and 60 minutes after the bike caught push notification (provided it has not already been returned to an anchor.)

* Check from within the app your Bicipalma usage history and, for example, make sure the trip closed correctly when you left the bike in its anchor point, or see any penalty for extra time.

* Be informed of any incident in public roads and in the transport network, regardless of the sender: Town Hall, EMT Palma or SMAP. Notices on important incidents are sent as an automatic notification to your phone, and you can always disable it in the Settings screen.
